setup_tokenizer: load a pretrained TemporalVertexCodec tokenizer from a checkpoint path and freeze its parameters
encode_vertices: encode a batch of 3D mesh vertex sequences into discrete quantized token codes
decode_vertices: decode quantized token codes back into reconstructed 3D mesh vertex sequences
forward_codec: run the full TemporalVertexCodec forward pass to reconstruct mesh sequences and compute vq loss
compute_perplexity: compute the codebook perplexity metric from quantized token indices for evaluation
